Chapter 6877: Call Some People

Chapter 6877: Call Some People

Nevertheless, it was difficult to tell whether Skyshroud would stand with Fallen Ten in the future.

“Haha, Immortal Devourer, you are still too young to fathom the true depth of our faction.” Extinguish said.

Immortal Devourer’s expression changed slightly.

“Even if it does, it won’t save you two right now.” Netherlight uttered coldly.

Meanwhile, Goldsilver Tree and the others didn’t expect the infighting among the invaders.

“Rest assured, I have never had any malice toward Fallen Ten. Everyone is on the same side and our mission is to strengthen Devouring Abyss.” Immortal Devourer said.

The duo didn’t believe this. However, it seemed he was telling the truth at least for right now. After all, he could just kill the two of them instead of wasting breath.

“What are you after?” Mirage asked.

“His Excellency is back.” Immortal Devourer said.

The two exchanged glances and understood this wasn’t the time for personal vendetta.

“I’m sure you know His Excellency didn’t give commands to Fallen Ten alone.” Immortal Devourer added: “Given the size of our faction, we should work together to help His Excellency.”

Mirage and Extinguish understood Immortal Devourer’s intent. Currently, Dark Realm was in charge. However, Immortal Emperor Gu Chun was an outsider.

They preferred for Devouring Abyss to be in charge instead of Dark Realm. Therefore, the emperor was an obstacle to His Excellency’s return.

“What do you suggest?” Mirage asked.

“We must continue our pact and in the future, we shall rule the alliance.” Immortal Devourer said.

The duo was naturally tempted because they stood no chance against Dark Realm alone.

After a glance at each other, both agreed: “Very well.”

“It’s a promise.” Immortal Devourer said.

“No going back.” The two agreed.

“Boom!” Meanwhile, Bear Immortal defeated the two immortals with the help of his banner.

“You two aren’t enough.” He declared imperiously despite being covered in bloody wounds.

“Oh, a natural primordial treasure?” Immortal Devourer gazed intensely at the banner.

“Deal with this outsider first.” Netherlight suggested.

“Indeed, devour him first.” Immortal Devourer agreed.

“It’s a feast.” Mirage and Extinguish approached the bear.

“It’s been a long time since the last immortal meal.” Extinguish salivated.

These fallen immortals didn’t mind teaming up against the opponents in the slightest.

“Not getting away this time.” Big-foot Immortal said.

“Five against one?” Bear asked.

“Of course, this is Stygian, honor is unrealistic here.” Mirage sneered.

“Wait a second.” Bear said.

“Got some last words? Go for it since you won’t have the chance soon.” Extinguish laughed.

“No, no last words, just have to call some people.” Bear laughed.

“What?” The opponents were confused.

Bear took out an old bell and shook it, issuing pleasant chimes.

The sound waves caused ripples and summoned a portal, allowing radiant figures to appear.

These were immortals with unique auras.

One had an exuberant spirit, always a spirited youth regardless of how much time had passed.

Another was the embodiment of steadiness, capable of subduing any unrest.

The third possessed an ancient yet ordinary grace like that of a mortal, and he was not the last one to come out...
